import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pydantic

class Hotel(pydantic.BaseModel):
    name: str
    rating: float | None = None
    price_range: tuple[float, float] | None = None


def get_hotels(scraper_url, destination="Paris", start_date="May 1st", end_date="May 5th"):
    response = requests.get(scraper_url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    
    hotels_list = []
    
    for card in soup.find_all('div', class_='card'):
        name = card.find('h2', class_='title').text.strip()
        
        if (price := card.find('span', class_='price')):
            try:
                price_low, price_high = map(float, price.text.split('-'))
                hotels_list.append(Hotel(name=name, rating=None, price_range=(price_low, price_high)))
            
            except ValueError:  # Price not shown
                continue
        
        else:
            continue
    
    return hotels_list


def get_cheapest_hotel(hotels, max_price=210):
    cheapest = None
    
    for hotel in hotels:
        if hotel.price_range[0] < max_price and (cheapest is None or hotel.price_range[1] > cheapest.price_range[1]):
            cheapest = hotel
            
    return cheapest
